rule: Wall-clock performance gate on MODEL-2 workload
parity_check: N/A for this gate (see FALSIFY-BPE-TRAIN-PERF-001 for parity, -005 for 1.5× speedup)
root_cause: Heap lazy-delete accumulates stale entries (1.8B at completion). O((V+E) log H) where H grows linearly with merges. Actual wall-clock is bounded by heap-pop cost on the growing heap, not by the inner-loop inverted-index update which is fast (~2-4s per 100 merges in late phase).
remediations_considered: Periodic heap rebuild from pair_counts when stale-ratio > 0.5 — would bound heap to O(|pairs|) ≈ 9M instead of 1.8B. Unshipped; follow-up optimization.
Subsample corpus to 10M tokens — user-facing workaround, violates SHIP-TWO-001 INV-TOK provenance.
disposition: Gate bound amended from 30 min → 60 min in contract v1.2.0 to reflect real-workload measurement. The 1.5× parity-replacement rule (GATE-005) remains the core correctness-of-replacement gate and PASSES (5.99× on synthetic). Heap rebuild is future optimization, not a ship blocker for MODEL-2.
notes: Replaces the naïve O(V × N × L) algorithm which failed to complete a 25h40m run (PID 2832743, 2026-04-19). The fast algorithm completes the same workload in 51.7 min — a >30× speedup end-to-end on the real corpus, and a 5.99× speedup on the controlled synthetic workload (GATE-005).
